title: Accounting of Disclosures Frequency and the Repeat Accounting Fee — Medical Records Request (Release of Information) Policy
content:
HIM policy of Riverbend Regional Health on how Accounting of Disclosures Requests under the Medical Records Request (Release of Information) product are counted against one another and when an accounting carries a fee.

## Policy clause

Accounting of Disclosures Requests are counted across all of the patient's requests: the first accounting in any rolling 12 months is free (the product's number of free accountings per rolling 12 months), and each further accounting in the same 12 months carries the product's repeat accounting fee as one repeat accounting fee component on the request. Where the product's terms provide that the patient is told of the repeat fee in advance, the patient is told of the fee before processing and may withdraw or narrow the request without charge.

## How "the same 12 months" is counted

- **Window**: the rolling 12 months ending on the received date of the Accounting of Disclosures Request being decided.
- **What is counted**: the patient's earlier Accounting of Disclosures Requests whose received date falls in that window and whose status is anything other than withdrawn. A denied, fulfilled, closed or still-open earlier accounting request counts; a withdrawn one does not.
- **Across requests**: the count runs across all of the patient's requests, not within one request.
- **Result**: with no counted earlier accounting request, the accounting being decided is the first in its 12 months and is free; with a counted earlier accounting request, it is a further accounting in the same 12 months and carries one repeat accounting fee.

## Cases on hypothetical histories

| Hypothetical earlier Accounting of Disclosures Request of the same patient | Counted in the window? | The accounting being decided |
|---|---|---|
| none | — | first in its 12 months: free |
| received 5 months before the new request's received date, fulfilled | yes | further accounting: one repeat accounting fee |
| received 5 months before, withdrawn | no | first in its 12 months: free |
| received 5 months before, denied | yes | further accounting: one repeat accounting fee |
| received 14 months before, fulfilled | no, outside the window | first in its 12 months: free |

## Advance notice of the fee

When an accounting is a further accounting in the same 12 months and the product's terms provide for advance notice, the patient is told of the repeat accounting fee before processing and may withdraw the request or narrow it without charge.
